name: Pistol squat
description: A full-depth squat on one leg with the other held straight out in front. Supported and box versions build the strength and balance first.

steps.label: Bodyweight squat
steps.cue: Sit deep with your heels down and chest up.

steps.label: Bulgarian split squat
steps.cue: Reps per leg; keep your front knee tracking over your toes.

steps.label: Assisted pistol squat
steps.cue: Reps per leg; use the support only as much as you need.

steps.label: Pistol squat to box
steps.cue: Reps per leg; touch the box lightly, do not sit and rest.

steps.label: Pistol squat to low box
steps.cue: Reps per leg; reach your arms forward to balance.

steps.label: Full pistol squat
steps.cue: Reps per leg; heel stays down all the way to the bottom.
